text.tspan: All bends DOWN! This orientation is chosen
because after the cut, all plasma dross will be on the bottom
side of the flat, which will have grider marks after dross removal.
Those unsightlhy grinder marks end up being on INSIDE of chassis.
Layer Names in InkSkape do not show
up after importing drawing into SheetCam. SheetCam
WILL however use colors as layers, so we set each layer
Using claculated bend deduction from send-cut-send calculatorr
which states a bend deduction for 5052 .090 aluminum of .141,
which puts the bend line in the center of that, .07"
NOTE: Layout is INSIDsE chassis, so chassis drawing must be flipped horizontally to orient correctly.
NOTE: Chassis flat view is from top/OUTSide!
NOTE: Flat layout drawing in flat_layout_large_chassis.svg.
Make flat changes there, adjust red outside outline, and copy
DONE: Increase pot tap hole spacing
Move boost label further from hole
Cathode terminal under Power input module
